$comment: Block ot-weekdays-18-34 (L-067), proper of time: Mon-Sat of Ordinary Time weeks 18-34, Years I and II. Weeks 24 and 25 are not here: their keys belong to the seed block (seed/proper-of-time.json). Week 34 Year I is imported from LitCal (import/litcal/ot-weekdays-18-34.json); LitCal is empty for every other weekday of weeks 18-34 at the pinned revision, so the rest is filled from the OLM 1981 structure, cited by OLM lectionary number, with psalms in Hebrew numbering. Pages (p?) and printed forms are recorded by the verifier. Every entry is provisional until checked against the Kenyan Lectionary (docs/decisions/011-lectionary-source.md).
